posts.title: Dotoist: Personal Task Manager
posts.description: Meet Dotoist: a free & open-source task manager built for speed and simplicity. Ridiculously fast. Offline-first. No Big Tech account required. Boards, tasks, notes, calendar, time tracking, and reminders, all in one place. Works on any device with a browser. Based on DoTo open-source project. Perfect alternative for Todoist and other todo apps.

posts.title: A Positive/Complicated Opinion About AI
posts.description: Think about AI's impact on developers' lives the same way C affected assembly programmers. Just as we don't need to write an entire OS in 1s and 0s anymore, we won't need to write every line of code ourselves either. The jobs are still there, and the need to build things is still there.
